content: Bi Mexihase surusan mutun ta mase suru.
Libai Giekude Qiorunni Huighaku
Ta yandeliuzhe mii jilazhi da bi tande chonjizhi ogisei goude bareizho, ingiese bi tai kuaizho.
Jien ere kunlai qiorunshi Mexiha wo, biereilai qiorunshi ere kun wo, Mexihai qiorunshi Huda bikui bi tande mejieghaku duran wine.
Ere kun onxian giekude, Hudai kielienyi kieliekude qiorunne huighase qiorunne shizheghazho.
Biereila onxian giekude Hudai kielienyi kieliekude qiorunne ulie huighase qiorunne shizheghazho. Qingiese qiorunne dulisan niekielien wo.
Biereila qiorunne ulie huighase usunne ghigha. Usunne ghigha, dulidene shizhese qiorunne huigha.
Ere kun indan qiorunne ulie huighakuni wo, hheshi Hudai yanzi, kuaikui wo. Biereishi ere kunyi kuaiku wo.
Ere kunshi biereise khizhesan pusho, biereishi ere kunse khizhesan wo.
Da ere kunshi biereide oluzhi zhayaghasan pusho, biereishi ere kunde oluzhi zhayaghasan wo.
Ingiese biereila qienxienni yenyinghala qiorun jierene indan jihao giekuni wo. Ene jihaoshi qienli dourashiku isi wo.
Ingieliuzhe Ezhanni miende ere kun uwoshi ulie olune, bierei kun uwoshiye ulie olune.
Bierei ere kunse khizhesan mutun ere kunye biereii tungo giezhi khizhezho. Soyujila man Hudase khizhezho.
Ta goyalane sumula, biereila Hudase onxian giekude qiorunne ulie huighase heshi winu?
Ere kunla fudu usun liuise shizhekui ta yenlai ulie mejienu?
Biereila fudu usun liuise kuaine. Usunshi biereii qiorunni huighakude ogizho.
Niezhan kunla jianjindune giese bijiende intu xigon uwo, Hudai jiohuiladeye intu xigon uwo.
Ezhanni Heifan
Ede bi tai fenfulane giesande tai ulie kuaine. Ta hhantulase haochu uwo, zinie huaichu wo.
Ji 1 gieshi bi chenliese ta nie jiohuinughunla libai giene giezhi hhantulakude tai dunda danlinraku shiqin wine. Ene kielienyi bi gouji xianxin giezho.
Tai dunda danlinraku shiqin kenjin khizhene, ingiekude caigie hhezighan shixinji giesan kunlai uzhezhi khizhene.
Ta hhantulakude ijiesanni Ezhanni heifande ulie sanane.
Ta ijiekude man qianlazhi xien ijiezho. Niezhan kunla ijiezhi chudu dazho, niezhan kunla ochi sudozho.
Tande ijiezhi ochiku gie uwonu? Pse ta Hudai jiohuii meilade uzhezhi yama witu kunlai shizheghanu? Bi tai matugie kieliene? Tai kuaimu? Intu shiqin jiere bi tai ulie kuaine!
Bi Ezhanse jienliesanni tande chonjizhi ogiwo. Ezhan Ersani ghudandusan hhe xii ginanni barei
mafan kieliedene ghulu kieliewo, "Eneshi tande oluzhi ogisan mii beye wo. Ta mii jilazhi enei gie."
Ijie baludene qingiezhi beizii barei kieliewo, "Ene beizishi mii chusunghala shini yenjisan kielien wo. Ta niefanie ochikude mii jilazhi enei gie."
Ta niefanie ene ginanyi ijiezhi ene beizii ochikude Ezhan iretula Ezhan duya ijiesan shiqinni kunlade man mejieghazho.
Ingiese yan kunliuzhe Ezhanni ginan, beizii lon ijiezhi ochise Ezhanni beye, chusunyi kuighazho.
Kun indan goyade zui winu uwo giezhi goyane goude sumuladene ene ginanyi ijie, ene beizii ochikuni wo.
Kun Ezhani beyeshi yan isi bikui ulie mejiedene ijiezhi ochise goyadene zui jinjizho.
Ene yenyin jiere tai dunda olon kunla zholierezhi gien kuwo, da fugusanye olon wo.
Matan goyalane goude jiencha giese ulie panjine.
Matanni panjikude Ezhan matanyi gonjizho, pse matanyi duyai kunlare hhantu zui jinjine.
Ingiese mii gaijiula, ta hhantulazhi ijiekude nieniene saghei.
Kien oliesuse xien giedene ijie, pse hhantulasanni man panjine. Psedu shiqinlani bi iredene nanpei gieye.
